title: docs(qa): 18.0 sweep anchor round 4 — §3 accuracy corrections in studio-authoring, records-forms, dashboards and search
body:
Refs #24579
Clause-②: no

The fourth dispatch of the 18.0 release sweep's wave anchor. It covers §3's checklist-accuracy findings for the four UI-facing areas: studio-authoring, records-forms, dashboards and search. It takes round 2's additions for them (comments `6272032736` and `6272314386`), the Tier 1 `automated.ref` notes that land in these files, and the leftovers round 3 named.

This PR edits the ledger only. The diff is the four `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` files the claim names, with no product code, test or pin in either repository. Each edited item takes one `revision` bump and one `history` row that names the run records it rests on. Several findings on one item make one revision. Every finding was re-derived from source before it was edited:

- the server at objectstack base `f89d29e382`, re-checked after merging `origin/main` `bfc1539fe0`; no cited source moved in between;
- the console at the shipped pin `.objectui-sha` `4016370af3c9`, cross-checked at objectui `main` `282b138c07`, where every cited fact is the same;
- the run's own captured evidence, where the record has it.

Findings that did not hold are left alone, and each is listed below with the reading that refutes it.

The history rows, and the recipe's provenance line, carry the placeholder ref `#PENDING-24579R4`, because the PR has no number until it is created. A follow-up commit on this branch swaps exactly those strings for this PR's number.

## Findings left alone, each with the reading that refutes it

studio-authoring
- `draft-publish-lifecycle`, the draft-discard note ("discarding a draft uses `?state=draft`"): true of the door, since `META_ITEM_RESET_PARAMS` is `state`, `dropStorage`, `package` and `member`. But no step of any studio-authoring item discards a draft. The only DELETEs in the file are overlay resets, so the note has no clause to correct.
- `draft-publish-lifecycle`, "a scratch dashboard in a namespaced package needs the NS_ prefix": refuted. The prefix rule judges objects only. `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts` says "every `object.name`", and publish-drafts' preflight skips non-object drafts (`if (d.type !== 'object') continue`).
- `draft-publish-lifecycle`, rollback refuses `?package=`: true, but no step sends it, so there is no item claim to correct.
- `expression-editors`, both #24604 notes (validate_expression has no RLS site; the package door has no Save button): already on main through #24632 (revision 4).
- `first-run-loop`, step 6's Create-app checkbox already adds the nav item: already stated by the item's knownGaps[1] (SUPERSEDED, QA run #21056).
- `record-page-roundtrip`, "a `record:highlights` block without `fields` passes the draft PUT but fails publish": an observation with no clause behind it. The item adds a Card, not an empty highlights block.
- `permission-matrix-editor-ux`, the filter "owner" matches only owner_id: no clause names a filter term.
- `packaged-automation-studio-lock`, the disabled switch looks green, and canvas nodes are not React Flow nodes: cosmetic, plus a locator hint. The item names neither a colour nor React Flow (0 hits).
- `object-designer-roundtrip`, live spec F4/F1 stale: §2's objectui-live-e2e theme (see below).
- `doc-on-app-menu` and `authoring-validation-not-persisted`: the objectui observations (empty main area, menu highlight, the "Auto-saving…" pill) are product observations, not item claims.

records-forms
- `crud-roundtrip`, the Tier 1 note that its `automated.ref` over-claims: refuted. The ref already scopes itself: "acceptance[6]'s READONLY half ONLY … Every other clause still needs the run". #24598 read the same: only the readonly half of clause 6.
- `object-hook-lifecycle`, "the steps' `$select` — the by-id read door accepts `select` only": no step of this item spells `$select`, and records-forms.json has 0 hits.
- `list-view-capabilities` negative[0], "the refusal code is not INVALID_FILTER": refuted at source. `packages/objectql/src/boolean-comparand-declared-type-door.ts` refuses any non-boolean string against a boolean field with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, naming the field, and that file is unchanged since `ba4afcc2`. The finding's staging recipe was taken.
- `list-view-capabilities` step 7, the switcher lives under Display → Layout: a locator hint. The step names no location.
- `validation-rule-type-matrix`, #24558's "describes the advisory hit as server-log only": already on main (revision 3 reads the write answer's `warnings`).
- `field-group-visible-when`, the item cites the console pin `1fb1ced36243`, now `4016370af3c9`: a dated reading that still holds at the shipped pin. `plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts` passes `visibleWhen` through, `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` writes `{ group }` references, and both groupVisibleWhen-11630 pins exist. The record's other two notes (the grouped section renders above the ungrouped fields; an invalid CEL `visibleWhen` is accepted at authoring) are observations. No clause claims either one.
- `predicate-relationship-traversal`, "use `filter=` JSON, not an OData `$filter=`": no step of this item sends a list filter.
- `cascading-options`, the invite recipe needs accept-invitation: already stated by the item's personas[1] ("a member invited with role 'admin' who has ACCEPTED the invitation"). The RUNNER.md recipe is outside the file surface (see below).
- `import-wizard-encoding-and-hints` step 3, Contacts' Import entry sits in the overflow menu: no step names the entry's location.
- `concurrent-edit-conflict`, the dialog buttons read "Reload latest / Overwrite anyway / Cancel": the item names the two actions by their verbs (Reload / Overwrite), which is accurate shorthand. It is also one of the seven hand-driven now-PASS items, and its stated clauses hold.
- `cascading-multilevel-and-clear` (test ids), `lookup-picker-create-new` (the typed term is not pre-filled, an observation by the record's own words), `bulk-select-all-matching` (the header search opens the palette), `adhoc-filter-sort-builder` ("Add filter" persists an incomplete row) and `gantt-interactions` (null-date tasks drawn as milestones): locator hints or product observations, with no item claim behind them.
- `view-type-gallery`, the map base style is unreachable from the sandbox: an environment fact, not an item claim. The RUNNER environment table is outside the file surface.
- `action-param-widgets`, the `p_richtext` helpText contradicts the textarea widget: that copy is showcase metadata, which is product code, and the ruling forbids product edits.
- `record-discussion-mentions`, the mentioned member sees "You don't have permission to view comments": a possible by-design observation, with no clause. acceptance[8]'s scratch-object channel is already in steps[12].
- `v18-semantic-defaults`, "the canonical file-DB boot works too": a suggestion.

dashboards
- `strict-widget-rejects-stray-keys`, "a pending draft is unreadable until publish": refuted. `GET /meta/dashboard/NAME?state=draft` reads the draft (`META_ITEM_READ_PARAMS` includes `state`). Only `?mode=draft`, a save-door parameter, is refused on the read. The inspector half was taken.
- `empty-null-bucket-boundaries`, the 79-click 2020 window, the two-month seed and the single-bucket recipe: runner-efficiency suggestions. The step's "a week in 2020" works, and the `seed-data-thin` and `single-datapoint` traps are already listed.
- `chart-type-matrix`, a thin seed for trend charts: the `single-datapoint` trap is already listed.
- `global-filters-rescope`, the inspector labels the date binding `dateRange`: cosmetic.
- `analytics-exposure-gate-and-measure-aggregate`, "stock has no cube over an unexposed object — scratch app required": already stated by fixtures.requires[1]–[2].
- The console route spelling note: both spellings work, and no item claims otherwise.

search
- `pinyin-flag-both-sides`, the lookup-picker part of step 5 was not exercised: run coverage, not an inaccuracy.
- §3's "`notify` assignee must be a user id; the `job` timeout probe needs a `retryPolicy`": these are `integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery` and `integration-system.job-scheduled-run` (QA run #24575), and `integration-system.json` is excluded (open PR #24588).

Their "pin covers no clause" side is left alone. The stated-clause errors on five of them (related-list, adhoc, calendar, grid-personalization, import-job) were taken.
- §4 fixture gaps: `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix` negative[0] (no door authors a non-evaluable CEL rule).
- Outside the file surface: RUNNER.md's "Invite, then sign up" recipe invites with role `member` and does not say that a non-member role takes effect only after `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/accept-invitation` (QA run #24616). RUNNER's environment table would also take the sandbox map-tile fact.

Their repairs are at objectui `main`, after the shipped pin `4016370af3c9`, so none of them makes a clause true again at the pin, and their FAIL clauses keep their product-defect disposition. #24619 is open. Its row (b) is why `object-hook-lifecycle` acceptance[8] now states the shipped 500 envelope and scores against #24619 rather than re-filing it.

It re-parses the file and asserts three things: the document equals the old one with the declared operations applied, every other item is unchanged in value, and each edited item's changed leaf paths stay within the declared fields, the `revision` and one new history row.
